body.description: Fanlet: a little ceiling fan creature that walks on its pull-chain legs, five wooden blades as a spinning crown, frosted glass light dome as its face with a soft eye glow, brass motor housing, swaying and dainty. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
